name: @portfolio/db
description: Tipos generados y consultas tipadas del CMS del portafolio (Supabase/PostgreSQL).

scripts.generate:types: pnpm dlx supabase@3.1.0 gen types typescript --local --schema public > /tmp/database.types.ts && pnpm dlx oxfmt@latest /tmp/database.types.ts && cp /tmp/database.types.ts src/database.types.ts
